items.name: LIMITER_LIMITS
items.doc: The precision limiter's travels, rendered into `omx_contract_limits.h` as `OMX_LIMITER_*` by the engine's limits generator, so `mix_limiter.h` reads them and never restates one (R-094). The ceiling is a TRUE peak in dBFS (the ×4 detector); the look-ahead sets the declared latency; the release is the envelope's time constant on the gain depth.
